dialogues.speaker: Estragon
dialogues.text: Yes. Dmitriev... I'm waiting for him to come pick up the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Estragon
dialogues.text: It feels as though I've been waiting here for a lifetime, and yet, I don't dare leave this spot to find him.

dialogues.speaker: Estragon
dialogues.text: Perhaps he's just run into some trouble along the way... Maybe I should be more patient. He should be here soon.
